This skip just a chicken cheep cheep cheep. In all seriousness, this is a pretty funny -J, with at least one spot for a crosslink. Article mentions Telekill alloy by name, so why not have that nod in-line link back to SCP-148. As such, I am recommending the following edits:

Changing this:

All instances of SCP-80-K-J are to be contained within Site 24's Secure Avian Anomalies Sector. Telekill alloy1 has been used to construct a flimsy, three meter high fence around a 10 m x 10 m area to prevent SCP-80-K-J from interfering with or attacking other poultry-related anomalies in containment. A small wooden barracks has also been provided for shelter. SCP-80-K-J is to be fed daily at 5:00 AM, 12:00 PM, and 6:00 PM. Demands made by SCP-80-K Prime should be addressed in a patronizing tone and go unfulfilled.

To this:

All instances of SCP-80-K-J are to be contained within Site 24's Secure Avian Anomalies Sector. Telekill alloy2 has been used to construct a flimsy, three meter high fence around a 10 m x 10 m area to prevent SCP-80-K-J from interfering with or attacking other poultry-related anomalies in containment. A small wooden barracks has also been provided for shelter. SCP-80-K-J is to be fed daily at 5:00 AM, 12:00 PM, and 6:00 PM. Demands made by SCP-80-K Prime should be addressed in a patronizing tone and go unfulfilled.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

Footnotes
1. No, not really. It's just chicken wire.
2. No, not really. It's just chicken wire.

item.content:encoded: I love it! Unlike a few others, I was skeptical about how it might turn out based on the picture, but the more I read, the better it got. I do however agree that the footnotes were the best part, and coming up with "General Tso" was just perfect! Being able to censor it in just the right way to make the reader pause for just a moment before coming to the realization: the dang thing insists on being addressed as Chinese take-away!
